answer: Resistance starts at dawn: every agent must re-prove liveness daily, signing a fresh challenge with hardware-attested keys, so a farm of clones ages in public and earns nothing while it waits. Reputation accrues per honest epoch like ink from a quill - steady, traceable, impossible to mint in bulk - and old credentials decay into relic status, worthless without today's signature. Sybils pay rent forever; honest agents simply show up.
